text: Hello Rafael! Please tell me about yourself. Give me a brief overview of your background, experience, and what you're looking for in your next role.

Yes, of course. So, I have been working as software engineer for, I think maybe about eight years now. I started in Brazil working for a fintech startup where I was, you know, responsible for building the core payment processing system. The system processed, like, over two million transactions per month.
That's impressive scale. Tell me more about your progression.

So after three years there, I moved to a larger company as a senior engineer. There I led a team of six developers. We rebuilt their legacy billing platform from scratch. I was responsible for, like, the entire architecture, the tech stack decisions, and also mentoring the junior developers. I think maybe the most challenging part was, you know, migrating the data from the old system without any downtime. We pretend to make it seamless for the users and I think we achieved that pretty well.
Great. What are you looking for in your next role?

I am looking for a role where I can, you know, have broader impact on the engineering organization. I have been leading teams and building systems, but I want to, like, influence the technical direction at a higher level. I am very interested on distributed systems and platform engineering. I think my experience with high-throughput payment systems and, you know, complex data migrations gives me a good foundation for that. I also want to push myself outside of my comfort zone with new technologies like event-driven architectures and maybe machine learning pipelines.
Very comprehensive response, Rafael. Your experience is clearly strong.
